column1: # higher-order audit's §5.9 "no while" gap, 2026-08-21). The condition
# re-evaluates before every iteration; body values accumulate onto the
# stack as `for`'s do; break/continue work as in `for`; the Run loop's
# step budget meters every region, so a non-terminating condition trips
# lane lowers the word on the counted loop's frame since the
# thirty-seventh increment (2026-09-09; the graduated rows live in
# lang/spec/control.tsv §7). The two rows here still refuse — the
# ledger pins each reason; the interpreter is the oracle.
def c (flex {n:0}) end while [(c get 'n') lt 3] [ set 'n' ((c get 'n') add 1) c end if ((c get 'n') eq 2) [continue] end (c get 'n') ]
